findings.issue: [P1] Missing token validation before session lookup
findings.explanation: Line 15 returns null when token is empty, but does not validate the token signature before calling sessionStore.lookup() on line 22. An attacker-controlled token will reach the lookup unchecked.
findings.recommendation: Verify token signature via verifyJWT(token) before line 22.

evidence.claim: sessionStore.lookup is invoked on the unverified token
